The project

Changing the game in high-end residential living

Banksii is a ten-storey, glass-wrapped residential building at 169 Wellington Road, East Brisbane, rising above the treetops of Raymond Park with views across the city and the river. Designed by MAS Architecture, its curved form, façade detailing and interiors take their cue from the native Banksia flower.

Inside are 72 one, two and three-bedroom residences with floor-to-ceiling glazing, large balconies, natural oak timber floors, stone benchtops, brushed bronze fittings and SMEG kitchens. On the roof: an infinity-edge pool, sauna, BBQ and alfresco dining. Below: a residents-only gym on the podium, a ground-floor café and a landscaped laneway, plus secure basement parking.

Melrose is the builder. The client is handling the demolition, so you walk onto a clear site in February with the program ahead of you.

Your first months

In early, ready to go

Join Melrose and get early engagement with the project team: drawings, program, buildability and the subcontractor packages before a shovel hits the ground.

Jan – Feb

The client completes demolition. You set up the site, the logistics and the team, so day one on site runs to plan.

February

On site at Wellington Road. Basement, structure and the climb to ten storeys with your Structures Foreman.

The role

Run the site. Own the result.

What you’ll do

  • Lead Banksii on site from set-up through structure, façade, fit-out and handover.
  • Own safety, quality and program on the ground, and drive the daily and weekly plan.
  • Manage subcontractors and trades across a high-end finishes package.
  • Work hand in hand with the Project Manager on program, buildability and early-stage decisions.
  • Lead and develop your foremen and site team, and set the standard for the last five per cent.

A team built to win

  • A really well-resourced project: Project Manager, Structures Foreman, Finishes Foreman and a contract administration team behind you.
  • A builder and developer under one roof, so decisions get made quickly and close to the job.
  • Procore, Jobpac and Hammertech on every project.
  • Head office in Fortitude Valley, about ten minutes from site.
Who we’re looking for

A Site Manager with the runs on the board

  1. 4+Multi-residential projects delivered as Site Manager, start to finish.
  2. $50m+Each of them over $50m, with basements, structure, façade and high-end finishes.
  3. YrsReal tenure. You stay and finish what you start, and your CV shows it.
  4. 5%Obsessed with the last five per cent, because that’s what buyers remember.
The location

Right in the middle of Brisbane’s next chapter

Banksii sits beside Raymond Park on the edge of the Woolloongabba precinct, close to The Gabba, the future Brisbane Live arena, the Kangaroo Point Green Bridge and the Cross River Rail station, all being reshaped for the 2032 Olympics.

This is a building people will drive past for decades. You’ll be able to say you built it.
